{"subject":"Congrats on the Lightspark launch","body":"Hi,

Congrats on September's Lightspark launch: a Visa card programme that holds stablecoin balances and settles in USDC, issued by Lead Bank and processed by Lithic. Coming right after the Monavate partnership in August, it's a clear signal of how card programmes are expanding across fiat and digital currencies.

I'd love to hear how you're thinking about the next stretch. Would a 20-minute call in the coming weeks work? Happy to fit around your schedule.

Best,
Daniel"}
